zh-CN.title: 永久 VIP 成长奖励上线
items: 认领永久 VIP 可一次性获得 500 成长值，已有永久 VIP 自动补发
18 级奖励品质按新版方案重新校准，突出关键能力与典藏节点
成长值等级与安全条件上限分开展示
Niko、Fufu 等支持 VIP 提前使用的奖励增加明确标识

en.title: Permanent VIP Growth reward
items: Permanent VIP now grants 500 Growth Points once, including existing VIP members
Reward rarity across all 18 levels now follows the revised progression plan
Score level and security-gated effective level are now shown separately
Niko, Fufu, and other VIP early-access rewards now carry a clear label
